easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it.
When Extruder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Extruder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Extruder enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Extruder face-up.
Resolve the Extruder ability from step 1.
Repeat.
